directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: The driver invokes the existing findSimilarAcross export rather than implementing a scorer.
The same descriptor/model provenance, saved query vectors, per-file/time spread and requested final limit semantics; the original defaults stay available.
One JSON results answer on standard output, with real inputs supplied only at run time.
allowed_deltas: After the raw source-copy baseline is committed, read descriptor search_mode and generic query/descriptor settings from the supplied DATA.
Replace whole-file reads on every page with bounded fs.readSync spans over the same input bytes.
Allow an optional private old-baseline JSON file and compare exact returned file/time order through the existing answer shape; keep all real input paths and results outside public fixtures.
banned_substitutions: Another scorer, search index or result ranking implementation.
Private source paths, query vectors, media names or real baseline results embedded into public code or fixtures.
Adjusting ANN parameters, floors, precision or comparison tolerances to force a match.
